newsitem.title: USA: Rominger to stay as USDA deputy chief - Glickman.
newsitem.headline: Rominger to stay as USDA deputy chief - Glickman.

text.p: Richard Rominger will remain deputy agriculture secretary in the new Clinton administration, Secretary Dan Glickman said Friday.
"My partner and deputy, Rich Rominger, is staying on," Glickman told reporters but declined to discuss other possible changes in senior posts.
Undersecretary Gene Moos announced Thursday he was resigning, effective Dec 31.
Glickman's trade adviser, Paul Drazek, was mentioned as a possible successor but took himself out of contention.
